verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Bolna serves a live llms.txt at docs.bolna.ai that indexes its documentation as markdown (.md) pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. The docs also include a dedicated 'Build with AI' section. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no first-party guidance on how to point agents at the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.bolna.ai/llms.txt # Bolna Docs
